CustomField.description: Free-text note captured per ramp phase in the Quote Line Editor ramp modal (FB-815). Stamped on every line belonging to that phase. Kept separate from Line_Remarks__c so a phase note never overwrites a user's per-line remark.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Note for this ramp phase. Does not affect the per-line Line Remarks shown on the quote document.
CustomField.label: Ramp Phase Notes
